t: This is the College Building, part of City, University of London. It was designed by Edward William Mountford, an architect noted for his Edwardian Baroque style. Mountford also designed town halls in Sheffield, Battersea and Lancaster, and the Old Bailey here in London. He served as President of the Architectural Association and sat on the council of the Royal Institute of British Architects. He died young, at fifty-two, and one tribute said his death removed a very able and distinguished architect from the front rank of the profession.
